facts_raw.Funding / Support: US$10K equity-free capital + up to US$350K AWS credits
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0 equity/debt; Bessemer gets right to invest 30% of next financings up to $3M on lead terms
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 有明确创业团队/项目，能说明产品、市场和团队；公司阶段应处于早期，通常不应已明显超出 seed 阶段
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 Remote / global 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native；阶段以 Pre-company–pre-seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
facts_raw.Notes: Top-tier VC self-run program. Solo founders accepted; company not required at application.

facts.Funding / Support: US$10K equity-free capital + up to US$350K AWS credits
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: 0 equity/debt; Bessemer gets right to invest 30% of next financings up to $3M on lead terms
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: An identifiable team or project with a clear explanation of its product, market and founders; The company should be early-stage, generally no later than seed
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for Remote / global.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native; primarily at the Pre-company–pre-seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product
facts.Notes: Top-tier VC self-run program. Solo founders accepted; company not required at application.
